payload.text: pplr tags with no command prints the legacy usage naming tags.py (src/tags.rs USAGE), which names a file WP13 removes. Ruled a design D10 fix, at dc's ask: it changes no data file and no tested output. The usage names pplr tags, with its layout realigned and its exit status kept. A test pins the new text, so the fix stays. cc makes it a small commit in WP13's series, measured with the rest, and lists it in WP13's body as D10 requires. dc adds it to the CHANGELOG's Fixed. vc confirms D9's correction (318d065: edit out, cp only without -o) and ST0002's objective (53cfa89) against the code and the packaging.
